root_cause: Current main introduced translatable public copy that was not fully represented in the fail-closed static English cache.
The first AI Modelwijzer recovery covered its intended v2 labels but did not prove whole-current-main cache completeness after all final build transforms.
Repeated Netlify promotion therefore reached the build stage but could not become terminal production.

evidence.note: Recovery rebased onto the newest protected main so exact build parity can discover any additional cache gaps introduced after the original 16-entry diagnosis.

prevention: Treat static i18n cache completeness as part of production truth.
Validate the entire current-main public route set after final build transforms, not only files changed by the immediate candidate.
Never disable STATIC_I18N_REQUIRE_CACHE to make production pass.
Classify incomplete cache as build-content recovery, separate from Netlify transport/auth recovery.
